agentsYaml: agents/openai.yaml (plugin root or a selected skill) is provider configuration, never an asset. Top-level keys of a block mapping (plain or quoted) or of a single top-level flow mapping are classified: interface → interface.not-converted, policy / dependencies → agents-policy.not-converted, any other key → manifest-field-unknown. Any other structure is reported as agents-policy.not-converted (review-required), because it may carry policy that cannot be seen
boundsEnforcement: every emitted declaration is compiled through compileCodePuppyPackageDeclarationV1 with its derived assets before the adapter returns

fieldMapOnly.codepuppy.codex.identity.import-spec: identity and presentation taken from the import spec (subset conversion)
fieldMapOnly.codepuppy.codex.identity.manifest: identity and presentation taken from the manifest (full conversion)
fieldMapOnly.codepuppy.codex.license-attached: plugin-root licence bytes attached to the skill as LICENSE
fieldMapOnly.codepuppy.codex.manifest.mcpServers: manifest mcpServers resolved to a {mcpServers} file of the input
fieldMapOnly.codepuppy.codex.manifest.metadata: author / homepage / keywords / license / repository kept as metadata
fieldMapOnly.codepuppy.codex.manifest.skills: manifest skills resolved to a directory of the input

codepuppy.codex.agents-policy.not-conver.reason: agents/openai.yaml policy.* (implicit invocation) and dependencies.* (tool dependencies) are Codex provider settings

codepuppy.codex.app-connector.not-conver.reason: .app.json / manifest apps: connector authorization has no Alpha equivalent

codepuppy.codex.component-not-selected.reason: a component of the source package is not part of this conversion (not selected, or its name cannot be represented)

codepuppy.codex.hooks.not-converted.reason: root hooks.json, hooks/ or manifest hooks: Alpha publishes no engine hooks

codepuppy.codex.interface.not-converted.reason: manifest interface and agents/openai.yaml interface are Codex presentation fields

codepuppy.codex.manifest-path-unresolved.reason: manifest skills / mcpServers points at a path absent from the input; nothing under it is selectable and the conversion is a subset (R-13)

codepuppy.codex.mcp-config-shape.not-con.reason: manifest mcpServers is an inline object, the referenced file is a bare map, or a server entry is not an object; those servers are not selectable

codepuppy.codex.mcp-config-unreferenced..reason: a root .mcp.json the manifest does not reference; its servers are not selectable

codepuppy.codex.mcp-field.not-converted.reason: MCP field or MCP config top-level key without an Alpha mapping (includes env_vars)

codepuppy.codex.mcp-floating-version.blo.reason: MCP install recipe fails the catalog's exact-version gate (assertPinnedInstallSpec); the report is never wider than the gate

codepuppy.codex.mcp-local.reason: selected stdio server → mcp-local (command + args; literal env as environment, credential-reference env targets as requiredSecrets)

codepuppy.codex.mcp-oauth.not-converted.reason: provider-specific MCP OAuth settings (client ids, scopes, oauth_resource, auth) are not converted; generic login readiness uses the existing mcp-oauth prerequisite

codepuppy.codex.mcp-relative-command.blo.reason: MCP command contains / but is not absolute; it points into the provider package; the component is not produced

codepuppy.codex.mcp-remote.reason: selected type:"http" server with url → mcp-remote (credential header templates and secret prerequisites, or existing MCP OAuth readiness)

codepuppy.codex.mcp-timeout.not-converte.reason: MCP startup/tool timeouts are not converted

codepuppy.codex.mcp-version-pinned.reason: a floating version was replaced by the exact version from importSpec.pins (R-12)

codepuppy.codex.skill.reason: selected skills/<name>/ directory → skill@1 (targetDir codepuppy-skills); assets = every file except agents/openai.yaml

codepuppy.codex.skill-name-mismatch.bloc.reason: SKILL.md frontmatter name is missing or differs from the directory name; the host refuses such a skill

codepuppy.codex.skill-reference.not-conv.reason: skill text names a Codex built-in tool (frozen vocabulary, whole word) or another skill of the same package as $<name>; these do not exist under Alpha

codepuppy.codex.skill-script-runtime.not.reason: skill directory carries a script-class file (intake classifyFile); its runtime is not provisioned

codepuppy.codex.skills-unreferenced.not-.reason: a skills/ directory exists but the manifest does not reference it; its skills are not selectable

graph.root: first component by class order skill, mcp — byte order inside a class

groundTruth: real packages: every plugin in openai/plugins uses .codex-plugin/plugin.json; layouts without a real sample are refused, not guessed

identity.components: component id skill:<name> / mcp:<name>; component version = package version
identity.full: manifest name / description; the import spec only fills what is missing; displayName defaults to the package name
identity.subset: select is a proper subset of the selectable components, or a manifest path is unresolved → packageName, displayName and description come from the import spec (R-09)
identity.version: manifest.version; importSpec.version only when the manifest has none (a malformed manifest value is refused)

inlineSecret.error: E_CODEX_INLINE_SECRET — the path is reported, the value never
inlineSecret.literal: a non-empty string that is not a reference; references are exactly ${NAME}, $NAME, {NAME}, optionally after Bearer / Basic / Token and one space (case-insensitive prefix)
inlineSecret.nameNormalization: insert _ between a lowercase letter or digit and an uppercase letter; - . and space → _; uppercase; then the intake secret-word test (isSecretishParamName)
notCovered: positional secrets without a name hint (cmd sk-…)
secrets in skill text and non-MCP files
names without a secret word (PAT, DSN); URL credentials in their values are still S3

rules.S1: env.<NAME> secret-like name with a literal value
rules.S2: headers / http_headers entry named authorization, proxy-authorization, cookie, or a secret-like name, with a literal value
rules.S3: any string value that is an absolute URL with userinfo, or with a secret-like query parameter carrying a literal; an absolute URL that cannot be parsed is refused because it cannot be shown to carry no credentials
rules.S4: args --<name>=<v> / -<name>=<v> with a secret-like name and a literal v
rules.S5: args --<name> / -<name> followed by a literal that does not start with -
rules.S6: args <NAME>=<v> (env A=B form) with a secret-like name and a literal v
rules.S7: args single <Header-Name>: <v> with an S2 name and a literal v
rules.S8: any object key at any depth except the structural key names, secret-like with a literal value; keys normalizing to *_ENV_VAR, *_ENV_VARS, ENV_VARS, ENV_HTTP_HEADERS are exempt (their values are variable names)

inlineSecret.scope: every server object of every captured MCP config: the referenced file, an inline manifest object, a bare map, an unreferenced root .mcp.json

layout.claudeManifest: .claude-plugin/plugin.json is not read (fieldMap only); use adapt-claude-code explicitly
layout.mcpServers: manifest.mcpServers "./<file>", or root .mcp.json when the manifest omits mcpServers, shaped {mcpServers:{…}} → its servers are selectable; the field facts of every server in that file (cwd, timeouts, OAuth, other unmapped fields) are reported whether or not the server is selected, mappable, or nameable

refused.E_CODEX_MANIFEST_LAYOUT: a root plugin.json exists (alone or beside .codex-plugin/plugin.json); manifests are never merged

layout.skills: manifest.skills "./<dir>/" with <dir> in the input → each direct child holding SKILL.md is selectable
layout.unresolved: manifest skills / mcpServers path absent from the input → manifest-path-unresolved; the conversion is a subset (R-13)

mapping.http: type "http" + url → mcp-remote url; headers / http_headers → headersTemplate with {VAR} references + requiredSecrets; bearer_token_env_var → Bearer Authorization and env_http_headers → named header templates with required secrets; without credential headers use existing labelled optional mcp-oauth readiness
mapping.pins: importSpec.pins maps a selected server to an exact semver that replaces the version of the single non-exact <pkg>@<v> token; zero or several such tokens, a key that is not a selected floating server, or a non-exact value → E_CODEX_PIN_INVALID
mapping.skill: skill@1, targetDir codepuppy-skills; assets = the whole directory minus agents/openai.yaml; a plugin-root LICENSE / LICENSE.md / LICENSE.txt is attached as LICENSE when the directory has no licence file
mapping.stdio: command + args → behavior.command; literal env (names ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$) → behavior.environment; whole credential references → requiredSecrets targeting the source env key

excluded: code mode tools (no literal in the pinned source)
shell (a parameter name and an ordinary word)
toolVocabulary.match: whole word — no [A-Za-z0-9_] on either side — over the full text of every .md asset of a selected skill (frontmatter, prose, code); $<other skill of the same package> by the same rule
toolVocabulary.name: codexToolNamesV1
